items.title: Show HN: GuidedReview, a Chrome extension that helps review AI generated PRs
items.contentSnippet:

items.title: Show HN: Memcode launches a new terminal coding agent
items.contentSnippet:
Memcode is a new developer platform currently in public beta. It includes a coding agent, chat, reusable agents, DataHub, and a Lovable-style website generator.
The coding agent is heavily inspired by Claude Code and works across all frontier models as well as open-weight models such as Kimi and GLM.
Memcode was designed to stay in sync with you and behave more like a human coworker, with persistent memory and state recall. It grew out of constant frustration with existing coding agents.

items.title: AI coding agents are blowing through budgets — Replit, Kilo Code, and Symbotic explain how they're managing it
items.contentSnippet:
At Kilo Code, engineers are reading or writing code themselves only about 1% of the time now, according to co-founder Emilie Schario — the rest is agents. That shift is forcing new questions onto dev teams: which systems are safe to hand over, who cleans up when models goof up, how to support multi-model architectures, and whether skyrocketing token bills mean real progress or just burned IT budget.
